authority: Explicit research execution hypotheses under the user request to establish ASTRA6 profits; not teacher-verified and not broker execution permission.

candidate_contract.source: Every chronological ENTRY_REVIEW from the pinned engine after full cutoff processing; never chart-selected examples or old ICC/Vincent decisions.
candidate_contract.required: Original target known by deciding bar start and not already reached; child, parent zone, HTF link and both authorities still active after the decision cutoff.
candidate_contract.stop: Tapped local child zone far edge, frozen at decision: zone_low for long, zone_high for short.
candidate_contract.target: Exact original target in the ENTRY_REVIEW event; never a running or retrospectively revised endpoint.
candidate_contract.tie_break: Ascending decision_time_ms, then stable child_id; one position per policy; no exit-minute reentry.
candidate_contract.pending_cancellation: Cancel after observed original target exhaustion, stop crossing, parent/link/child/authority invalidation, unknown coverage, or expiry before fill; no later revival.

execution_hypotheses.entry: First observed executable-side quote strictly after decision_time_ms+latency_ms, before pending expiry. Long buys ASK; short sells BID.
execution_hypotheses.exit: MARKET_IF_TOUCHED hypothesis using actual crossing quote: long sells BID, short buys ASK. These are quote-priced simulations, not proven broker fills or linked limit-order execution.
execution_hypotheses.new_stop_activation: Strictly later quote timestamp than the observation or pivot confirmation that authorizes an update; equal-millisecond provider records retain original order.
execution_hypotheses.breakeven: After observed +1R, move stop to observed entry price on a later quote; fees mean price breakeven is not net breakeven.
execution_hypotheses.pivot_trail: After +1R, use only post-entry confirmed 1M lows for long or highs for short; activate strictly after known_at and never loosen. This confirmed M1 swing trail is a new hypothesis, not the native BOS-protecting-pivot exit contract.
execution_hypotheses.session_flatten: No entries from 19:59 through 21:59 UTC. First later observed quote before 20:00 executes a predeclared flatten. If missing, censor; never use the retrospective last quote.
execution_hypotheses.study_end: Flatten trigger at end_exclusive minus 60 seconds; execute only a subsequent observed quote strictly before the end; otherwise censor.
execution_hypotheses.coverage: A >60-second quote gap while exposure is open censors the unresolved trade and halts that policy. Do not infer a missing stop/target fill or erase residual exposure.
execution_hypotheses.price_units: One index point is a 1.0 change in quote price, distinct from the provider convention calling the second decimal digit a point.

cost_hypotheses.spread: Actual observed bid/ask spread is included through quote sides. No added duplicate spread.
cost_hypotheses.basis: USD52.5 per USD1million traded, each opening/closing leg, current lowest deposit/equity/volume JForex self-trader index tier; not a claim about the user account or historical fee tier.
cost_hypotheses.commission_points: rate*(observed entry price + observed exit price), per unit of index-point exposure.
cost_hypotheses.cost_stress: Deduct adverse cost separately from observed fill quotes. Do not rewrite observed prices.
cost_hypotheses.financing: No assumed financing rate. Planned flat buffer precedes daily closure/rollover; missed flatten is censored.
